title: Frosted bottle product film
prompt: A 15-second studio product film of a frosted-glass cosmetic bottle with a brushed-metal cap on a dark backdrop. Macro details, a slow hero reveal, and the product name on screen at the end. Loopable. 16:9.
goal: make the frosted bottle and its metal cap feel premium in fifteen seconds that loop without a seam
audience: shoppers on a product page and a looping screen at a counter

subject.description: a frosted-glass cosmetic bottle with a brushed-metal cap, 60 mm wide and 160 mm tall

limitsAcknowledged: frosted glass is approximated: both 3D lanes render an opaque clear-coated body in a pale tint, since neither material vocabulary carries transmission
the brushed-metal cap is a satin metal without a brush texture: neither lane carries anisotropy
the bottle is the procedural stand-in (body, neck and cap cylinders), not a modelled product; nothing is generated
the prompt names no product; the placeholder 'Vela' stands in until the user names it
no music: none was supplied and nothing is downloaded
